meta.description: Detects differential alternative splicing between conditions using rMATS-turbo (binomial LRT on junction counts), leafcutter (Dirichlet-multinomial GLM on intron clusters), MAJIQ V3 deltapsi/HET (Bayesian posterior on LSVs), SUPPA2 (empirical-null on TPM-derived PSI), or Shiba (junction-imbalance-corrected). Reports FDR-corrected significance and delta PSI effect sizes.
meta.data_note: Archived synthetic and real regressions were re-run against the exact source; two fresh inputs exercise coverage recall and the zero-intron guard.
meta.grade_note: Production Ready floors pass: static 93, execution and Layer 1/2 floors, and 35/35 assertions. MAJIQ is hedged, not executed evidence.
meta.executed_summary: 7 of 7 archived logical inputs executed, with two fresh edge checks incorporated into inputs 2 and 5; MAJIQ/VOILA is explicitly documentation-only and licence-gated.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Every number in the Skill that was re-run reproduced or is attributed to a simulation or a citation; no DOI/PMID/trial data is invented.

practice_boundaries.detail: No individual diagnosis or treatment advice; the nusinersen line is a literature effect size.

methodological_ground.detail: Warns about batch confounding, n=1, single-end/paired mismatch and SUPPA2 low-n behaviour; the aliasing guard refuses an unadjustable design.

code_usability.detail: Every code block (rMATS, regtools/leafcutter, SUPPA2 loop, Shiba config, pandas filter, confounder snippet, prioritisation snippet) ran verbatim or from a clean copy; the two shipped examples ran. MAJIQ commands were not executed (hedged as such).

functional_suitability.note: Every runnable claim checked reproduces: rMATS/leafcutter/Shiba/SUPPA2 commands, flags by design size, the SUPPA2 n table, planted truth. Deductions: MAJIQ/VOILA not runnable (hedged), the leafcutter batch = group sentence is wrong, the coverage filter loses recall, HET "conservative" line unsupported.

reliability.note: Post-run table checks (rows + FDR column) in the Skill and the rMATS example, aliasing check in the snippet, silent-failure modes documented. The leafcutter example has no check after clustering and fails opaquely on 0 introns; PSOCK hang description incomplete.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md 444 lines (under 500), usage-guide reduced to a pointer; dense but each section is used.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, design gate, measured tables and exact flags per design size; one dropped-in unverified MAJIQ line; PCA check worded for PC1 only.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language and example prompts in usage-guide; prompts do not mention batch or paired designs.

security.note: No credentials or eval; the examples quote variables and read paths from files. Batch-confounder snippet uses fixed formulas.

maintainability.note: Examples run from a clean copy and are checked; versions and check date stamped. No test harness ships; evidence numbers live in prose.

agent_specific.note: Description precise (no SOTA claim now), escape hatches (n=1 stop, single-patient hand-off, aliased batch), composability via Related Skills; MAJIQ path cannot be executed.
